_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::solid_mechanics#4 — on 4C 2026.2.0-dev WALL owns 2D structural cells. The full WALL QUAD4 line (MAT KINEM EAS THICK STRESS_STRAIN GP) runs to completion; 'SOLID QUAD4' is rejected with "Element 'SOLID' does not seem to know cell type 'quad4'." from core/fem/src/general/element/4C_fem_general_element_definition.cpp; and a WALL line carrying SOLID's shorter key set is rejected with "Required value 'STRESS_STRAIN' not found in input line" — a different message from a different code path, which is how you tell 'wrong element type' from 'right element type, wrong keys'. The SOLID diagnostic never contains the string 'wall' (SOLID_DIAGNOSTIC_NAMES_WALL=0), so grepping the error for what you should have written teaches nothing. Distinct from linear_elasticity#4's fixture structural_2d_solid_quad4_not_wall, which probes the same vocabulary under a different physics key. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
expect_in_output: Element 'SOLID' does not seem to know cell type 'quad4'.
Required value 'STRESS_STRAIN' not found in input line

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: declare the 2D cell with the element type this build actually registers. The cell-type diagnostic vanishes and EXIT_SOLID2D becomes 0, so the fixture must go red.
_mutation.from: deck "SOLID QUAD4 1 2 3 4 MAT 1 KINEM nonlinear THICKNESS 1.0 PLANE_ASSUMPTION plane_stress"        "$TMP/solid.4C.yaml"
_mutation.to: deck "WALL QUAD4 1 2 3 4 MAT 1 KINEM nonlinear EAS none THICK 1.0 STRESS_STRAIN plane_stress GP 2 2"        "$TMP/solid.4C.yaml"

_mutation.note: remove the second pathology: give the WALL line its full required key set. The missing-key diagnostic vanishes and EXIT_WALL_SHORT becomes 0, so the fixture must go red.
_mutation.to: deck "WALL QUAD4 1 2 3 4 MAT 1 KINEM nonlinear EAS none THICK 1.0 STRESS_STRAIN plane_stress GP 2 2"                                                     "$TMP/short.4C.yaml"
